post.description: CollabOS signs the exact JSON request body with HMAC-SHA256 using the endpoint secret. Verify `v1=<hex>` from X-Collabos-Signature against HMAC_SHA256(secret, `${X-Collabos-Timestamp}.${rawBody}`). Delivery requests time out after 10 seconds, do not follow redirects, and are retried up to 8 attempts. `test.ping` is emitted only by the explicit test action and is not a subscribable event.

200.description: Any 2xx response marks the delivery as successful.

ApiKeyBearer.description: Pass a personal (`co_u_...`) or workspace (`co_w_...`) API key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. If both supported API-key headers are sent, Authorization takes precedence.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description: Alternative API-key header. Authorization Bearer takes precedence when both are supplied.

DashboardJwt.description: Authenticated CollabOS dashboard/session JWT used only for `/api/developer/...` management endpoints.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Clients must not construct or modify cursor values.

DeveloperEntryResponse.description: Sanitized developer entry object. Requirement evaluation data is projected to safe public fields.

apiKey.description: Returned only when a key is created. Store it securely; plaintext is not returned again.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret for this webhook endpoint.
